parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description:
Resource ID.

n ranges from 1 to `50`.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
Resource type. Currently, groups, plug-ins, and applications support tags. API-related operations use group-level tags:

- **apiGroup**

- **plugin**

- **app**

- **api**

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tag value of the resource.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
Tag key.

n ranges from 1 to `20`.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
Tag value.

n ranges from 1 to `20`.
